chat_entrypoint.save_writes: one thread/settings/update after a durable local claim
chat_entrypoint.cancel_writes: none; read current settings and close the same card

semantics.scope: current thread defaults for subsequent turns
semantics.service_tier_null: clear requested tier, not proof of fast off
semantics.unknown_write: read original frozen fields; never resend
semantics.changed_since_open: reject save and ask the user to reopen /model
semantics.reply_footer: first final-observation thread settings snapshot, not per-turn execution telemetry
semantics.reply_footer_fast: append fast only when enabled; omit labels and Fast-off text
